verdict.rationale: API-to-UI parity is a fair question for a SaaS monitoring platform like Sentry, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of a public API or its coverage relative to the UI, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path. The documented CLI and llms.txt are adjacent artifacts and do not show the API matches the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
